author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The shared route-segment policy still has a duplicate implementation in the app navigation helper.
findings.consequence: Future changes to route-segment safety can drift between shared server/catalog validation and internal navigation classification, causing one boundary to accept a segment the other rejects.
findings.evidence: The owned function at shared/utils/route-segment.ts:3-14 implements the same non-empty, max-length, trim, dot-segment, slash, percent, C0/C1-control, and lone-surrogate checks as app/lib/internal-navigation.ts:34-45. Repository search shows both exported functions are actively imported by different callers.
findings.recommendation: Make app/lib/internal-navigation.ts import or re-export this shared validRouteSegment function, so the route-segment policy has one implementation while preserving existing call sites.
